result.document_summary: A part of the San Diego Municipal Code (Chapter 2, Government) covering employee strike hearings, compensation, bonds, pension funds and city department descriptions, with no rental housing rules in this part.
result.notes: This part of the document (page labelled as the algorithmic rent-price-fixing section 98.1103, but the text here is Chapter 2 Administrative Code material) contains only municipal employment, hearing, bond, pension and city department provisions. It states no rule on rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions or algorithmic rent setting, so no rules are extracted. The actual text of section 98.1103 does not appear in this part.
